body.objective: Replace the obstructed projection of separately neutral Einstein and extra-Weyl sectors by the smallest exact derived correspondence that retains mixed cancellation of the five compact-Cauchy Taub charges, and determine what symplectic information descends through it.
body.stop_condition: Import EINSTEIN_WEYL_CONSTRAINT_ALGEBROID_KURANISHI_CARRIER_V1, EINSTEIN_WEYL_SYMPLECTIC_EXTENSION_CLASSIFICATION_V1 and the maximal ambient Einstein-to-Weyl cofiber sequence by exact path, result ID and hash. Construct the two-jet homotopy pullback/correspondence whose points retain a common Weyl tangent together with Einstein/extra components and an explicit five-charge cancellation homotopy, rather than requiring each component to lie in its own neutral fibre. Prove the derived differential squares to zero and that the certified balanced Einstein-minus/extra fixture is represented while each forbidden separate projection is rejected. Determine exactly which of the ambient inclusion, cofiber, Schur-complement pairing, moment maps and charge actions define honest maps, spans or only inclusion-dependent forms on the correspondence. Export a minimal exact sequence/span diagram, cohomology or tangent-space dimensions on the declared finite carrier, a method-distinct verifier and mutations that delete the mixed cancellation datum or falsely project to separately neutral sectors. If no such two-jet correspondence supports the required maps, certify the first exact obstruction and the smallest higher Kuranishi datum required.
body.current_gate: mixed-charge derived Einstein/extra correspondence after failure of separate neutral projections
body.forbid: no direct-sum or quotient language without a certified map; no setting the Einstein and extra moment maps to zero separately; no lift-dependent extra-extra sign called invariant; no fixed-group AMM theorem; no all-orders Kuranishi, bounded evolution, causality, particle, positivity or unitarity promotion
activates: a branch-readable nonlinear tangent-cone diagram retaining mixed charge cancellation
an invariant target for nonlinear and quantum branch maps
body.resource_hint: PROOF-FIRST BRIDGE SUCCESSOR. Work at the certified two-jet finite carrier first. The key object is a derived span/fibre product carrying cancellation data, not a repaired direct sum.
